assets.theme: Winter Pinecone Scale Linocut Giftwrap Field
assets.palette: forest charcoal, muted spruce green, natural ivory, warm paper
assets.prompt: Create an original reusable Christmas design texture for an artisan wrapping-paper and stationery brand. Depict a field of simplified pinecone scale clusters cut into two hand-carved linoleum printing blocks, with each cluster built from uneven nested wedges and short irregular gouge marks. Print in deep spruce green and near-black charcoal over matte warm ivory stock. The relief-print process must remain visible through small ink skips, natural registration drift, dry edge chatter and varied pressure; do not simulate a digitally perfect tile. Compose one horizontal 16:9 full-bleed artwork with organic clusters gathering along the right and lower margins while the middle-left remains quieter for later typography. Maintain consistent motif scale but avoid mirrored duplication and refrain from claiming the pattern is seamless. Art style: Hand-Carved Two-Ink Linocut, bold high-contrast graphic rhythm with physical ink texture and crisp carved negative shapes. Lighting is even like a flat archival print scan, with no photographic scene or cast-object shadow. No text, numbers, logos, watermarks, brand marks, stock labels, digital gradients or holiday clip-art icons.
assets.negative_prompt: fir-needle embossing, Christmas tree photo, smooth vector shapes, perfect repeating tile, lettering, logos

assets.theme: Mulled Spice Expressive Ink Corner with Open Cream Field
assets.palette: sepia umber, pale parchment, muted cinnamon, warm gray
assets.prompt: Make a reusable illustrated Christmas-season corner component for hospitality menu designers and winter recipe newsletters. Use an energetic dark sepia brush and diluted brown-gray washes to describe three recognizable whole spice forms: a curling cinnamon-bark quill, a single radial star-anise pod, and two small clove buds. Each object should be legible through disciplined brush economy, with slight dry-brush breaks, wet-on-dry granulation and varied ink weight; retain accurate basic spice anatomy without copying a historical painting. Arrange the spice shapes in a small diagonal cluster occupying the lower right and extending slightly beyond the edge. Compose horizontally at 16:9, keeping most of the left and upper center an uninterrupted pale cream field suitable for separately typeset menu prices or a greeting. Art style: Expressive Monochrome Ink-Wash Illustration, contemporary calligraphic energy, subtle handcrafted imperfections and restrained sepia tonal values. A gentle paper tone is acceptable, but avoid loud decorative flowers or paint splatters across the copy zone. Even illustration lighting, no table, cups, people, lettering, watermark, logos or fake labels.

Use a coherent midcentury-inspired palette of persimmon red, cobalt teal, muted mustard and warm off-white, without gradients or photographic textures. assets.theme: Finnish Himmeli Straw Tetrahedron Technical Layout
assets.palette: wheat straw, soft slate, warm ivory, muted forest green
assets.prompt: Produce an original Christmas craft design illustration for a workshop landing page and sustainable holiday craft brochure, inspired by the Finnish himmeli tradition. Show one small suspended decorative structure assembled from slender hollow rye-straw segments joined at clean corners into a physically coherent family of linked tetrahedra. The straw tubes must be straight, consistent in diameter and convincingly joined; intersections cannot pass through one another and no impossible extra rods should appear. Render the structure using a carefully controlled isometric view with fine warm-gray contour lines, sparse muted-wheat flat shading, occasional delicate green accent and only a few soft projected alignment shadows. Compose a horizontal 16:9 artwork with the structure occupying the right third and large uninterrupted warm-ivory copy space on the left. Keep the assembly readable without labels or numbered build steps. Art style: Fine-Line Isometric Craft Illustration, airy architectural draftsmanship and precise geometrical clarity, intentionally drawn rather than photographic. Preserve a clean design grid implicitly without showing grid lines. No people, tables, Christmas trees, words, logos, watermarks, construction instructions or invented cultural symbols.

assets.theme: Lion Dance Fringe Rhythm in Three-Layer Screenprint
assets.palette: vermilion red, warm golden ochre, deep peacock teal, natural cream
assets.prompt: Create a reusable Lunar New Year festival graphic for an event designer who needs a memorable banner and print-program cover. Depict a joyful abstract close motif of layered fringe associated with a traditional lion-dance costume: short curved fabric tassel shapes, scalloped trim and rounded repeating movement arcs, without showing a lion face, eyes, performers or a recognisable individual troupe design. Build the shapes as three independent hand-pulled screenprint ink layers in vermilion, golden ochre and deep peacock teal over natural-cream stock. Fine ink pinholes, slight edge registration shifts and modest silk-screen pressure marks should remain visible, while color fields read clearly at thumbnail size. Compose one horizontal 16:9 graphic with fringe rhythm sweeping up from lower right into the edge and leave the upper-left half calm and open for a separately typeset event title. Art style: Three-Color Hand-Pulled Screenprint, bold rhythmic silhouettes, tightly curated limited palette and tactile print irregularity. Use flat print illumination with no stage, crowd or photographic depth. No characters, words, faux Chinese lettering, logos, watermarks, fake vector promise or literal firework objects.

assets.theme: Amber Nian Gao Watercolor Slices on Minimal Wash
assets.palette: warm amber, caramel brown, light rice-cream, muted tea
assets.prompt: Create an original Lunar New Year ingredient illustration component for a specialty-food packaging designer and a vertical traditional-recipe story. Paint three believable simple slices of steamed sweet glutinous rice cake, nian gao, with softly rounded cut faces and a gentle amber-brown translucency. The internal density should look cohesive and slightly glutinous, with restrained darker caramel edges; avoid bread crumb, frosted cake, eggs, bean paste filling or any plated meal. Give each slice a different natural angle and loosely arranged spacing, drawn with transparent layered washes and finely controlled wet edges. Compose a portrait 9:16 airy background with two slices near the lower right and one modest slice at the outer bottom left. Preserve the entire upper half as a clean lightly tinted field for later typography and mobile UI margins. Art style: Transparent Layered Food Watercolor, realistic watercolor pigment pooling and delicately controlled contours with no inked outlines. Soft uniform paper illumination, warm welcoming understated food editorial mood. No product labels, invented words, printed recipes, logos, watermarks or cropped plate props.

assets.theme: Auspicious Carp Ripple Relief on Matte Porcelain
assets.palette: bone ivory, mist jade, muted coral, pale celadon
assets.prompt: Design a reusable Lunar New Year visual component for a premium gifting website hero and a contemporary seasonal greeting layout. Build one simple recognisable carp silhouette and two broad water-ripple arcs as a shallow sculpted relief in matte porcelain-like ceramic, resting within a continuous bone-ivory ceramic surface. Its form should remain culturally respectful and calmly symbolic: a coherent fish body with balanced fins and tail, no dragon features, no human face and no imitation of historical collectible porcelain designs. Use gentle rounded relief edges, believable shallow thickness, subtle clay grain and soft celadon-tinted depressions; a tiny coral accent can trace one peripheral ridge. Compose horizontally in 16:9 and keep the entire motif on the lower right, partially emerging from the frame while the left half stays open and low contrast for separate headlines. Art style: Soft Matte Ceramic 3D Relief Illustration, clean modern sculptural geometry, restrained surfaces and softly shaded depth rather than product photography or metallic glamour. Diffused studio skylight gives coherent gentle cavity shadows. No text, year numbers, trademarks, labels, logos, watermarks, physical room setting or false vector claims.
